players.bio: Arijanet Anan Muric is a professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Serie A club Sassuolo, on loan from EFL Championship club Ipswich Town, and the Kosovo national team.
Armand Laurienté (born 4 December 1998) is a French professional footballer who plays as a forward for Serie A club Sassuolo.

Aster Jan D. Vranckx is a Belgian professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Italian Serie A club Sassuolo on loan from German club VfL Wolfsburg, and the Belgium national team. On 3 December 2018, Vranckx signed his first professional contract with KV Mechelen. Vranckx made his debut for Mechelen in the 2019 Belgian Super Cup, in a 3–0 loss to Genk.
Benjamín Domínguez (born 19 September 2003) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays for Serie A club Bologna.

Cas Odenthal (born 26 September 2000) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Italian Serie A club Sassuolo. Odenthal was born in and grew up in Leersum and is the grandson of former Dutch international footballer Joop Odenthal. After playing youth football for FC Utrecht, Odenthal signed for NEC Nijmegen in summer 2018.

Cristian Volpato (born 15 November 2003) is a professional soccer player who plays as an attacking midfielder or winger for Serie A club Sassuolo. Born in Australia, he represented Italy internationally at youth level, before switching allegiance to Australia at senior level. Volpato was born in Camperdown, an inner western suburb of Sydney in Australia.
Daniel Boloca is a midfielder for Italian Serie A club Sassuolo.
Darryl Bakola (born 30 November 2007) is a French professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Marseille.

Domenico Berardi (born 1 August 1994) is an Italian professional footballer who plays as a forward for Sassuolo and the Italy national team. He began his club career with Sassuolo in 2012, helping the team win the Serie B title and earn promotion to Serie A in his debut season, later also being named the best player of the competition.

Duje Ćaleta-Car (born 17 September 1996) is a Croatian professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Serie A club Sassuolo and the Croatia national team. Ćaleta-Car was a member of the Croatian squad which ended as runners-up to France in the 2018 FIFA World Cup.
Edoardo Pieragnolo (born 3 January 2003) is an Italian professional footballer who plays as a left-back for Sassuolo.
Fali Candé (born 24 January 1998) is a Bissau-Guinean professional footballer who plays as a defender for Serie A club Sassuolo and the Guinea-Bissau national team.

Fedde Leysen (born 9 July 2003) is a Belgian footballer who plays for Belgian Pro League club Union SG as a defender. Leysen started his career with Jong PSV. He played 53 games in 2 seasons for Jong PSV in the Eerste Divisie. On 13 June 2023, Belgian side Union SG confirmed the signing of Leysen on a 3 year deal until 2026.

Filippo Romagna (born 26 May 1997) is an Italian professional footballer who plays as centre-back for Serie A club Sassuolo. Club career Early career Born in 1997, Romagna started his football career with the local team in his hometown, Fano. At the age of 10, Romagna moved to Rimini. In 2011, Internazionale tried to sign with Romagna but he eventually joined Juventus F.C. Youth Sector.
Giacomo Satalino (born 20 May 1999) is an Italian professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Serie A club Sassuolo.

Ibrahim Sulemana Kakari (born 22 May 2003) is a Ghanaian footballer who plays as a midfielder for Cagliari. Early life Hailing from Brong Ahafo in southwestern Ghana, Ibrahim Sulemana started football in his home town of Sunyani. It is also in this city that he was spotted by the Ghanaian player agent, Oliver Artur, who came to organize a day of detection in the region.
Ignace Van Der Brempt (born 1 April 2002) is a Belgian professional footballer who plays as a defender for Serie A club Como.
Ismaël Kenneth Jordan Koné (born June 16, 2002) is a professional soccer player who plays as a midfielder for Serie A club Sassuolo. Born in Ivory Coast, he plays for the Canada national team.
Jay Noah Idzes (born 2 June 2000) is a professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Serie A club Sassuolo. Born in the Netherlands, he plays for the Indonesia national team.

Josh Thomas Doig (born 18 May 2002) is a Scottish professional footballer who plays as a left-back or left wing-back for Serie A club Sassuolo and the Scotland national team. He has previously played for Hibernian, Queen's Park and Hellas Verona, and has represented Scotland at the under-21 level.

Kieron Thomas Bowie (born 21 September 2002) is a Scottish footballer who plays as a forward for Serie A club Sassuolo, on loan from Hellas Verona, and the Scotland national team. He has previously played for Raith Rovers, Fulham, Northampton Town and Hibernian.
Kristian Thorstvedt (born 13 March 1999) is a Norwegian professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Serie A club Sassuolo and the Norway national team.

Laurs Østerby Skjellerup (born 12 August 2002) is a Danish professional footballer who plays as a striker for Italian Serie A club Sassuolo. On 29 December 2023, Skjellerup was sold to Swedish Allsvenskan club IFK Göteborg, where he signed a four-year contract
Luca Lipani (born 18 May 2005) is an Italian professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Serie A club Sassuolo.
Luca Moro (born 25 January 2001) is an Italian professional footballer who plays as a forward for Serie A club Sassuolo.

Nemanja Matić (born 1 August 1988) is a Serbian professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for Serie A club Sassuolo. Starting his career as an attacking midfielder, Matić shifted to a defensive midfielder during his spell at Benfica. He is known for his consistent performances on the pitch and his combative style of play.
Nicholas Pierini (born 6 August 1998) is an Italian professional footballer who plays as a forward for Serie A club Sassuolo.
Patrick Amoako Nuamah (born 31 December 2005) is an Italian professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Serie B club Catanzaro on loan from Sassuolo.
Rafael Obrador Burguera (born 24 February 2004) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a left-back for Deportivo de La Coruña, on loan from Real Madrid.
Riccardo Ciervo (born 1 April 2002) is an Italian professional footballer who plays as midfielder or forward for Serie B club Sudtirol, on loan from Sassuolo.
Sebastian Wiktor Walukiewicz (born 5 April 2000) is a Polish professional footballer who plays as a defender for Serie A club Sassuolo on loan from Torino and the Poland national team.
Sebastiano Esposito (born 2 July 2002) is an Italian professional footballer who plays as a forward for Serie A club Cagliari, on loan from Inter Milan.
Stefano Turati (born 5 September 2001) is an Italian professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Serie A club Sassuolo.
Vasilije Adžić (born 12 May 2006) is a Montenegrin professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Serie A club Sassuolo, on loan from Juventus, and the Montenegro national team.

Yeferson Paz Blandón (born 13 June 2002) is a Colombian professional footballer who plays as a right-back for Italian club inter. Career Paz started his career with Colombian second tier side Cortuluá. Before the second half of 2020–21, he signed for Sassuolo in the Italian Serie A. On 28 July 2022, Paz was sent on loan to Serie B club Perugia.
